title: Debug: Part 1
summary: Classify syntax, runtime, logic, and timeout symptoms.
refresher: A **syntax error** blocks parsing, a **runtime error** interrupts execution, and a **logic error** finishes with the wrong result. Reproduce the failure and change one cause at a time.

blocks.body: A **syntax error** blocks parsing, a **runtime error** interrupts execution, and a **logic error** finishes with the wrong result. Reproduce the failure and change one cause at a time. Classify syntax, runtime, logic, and timeout symptoms.

Debugging starts with classification. A syntax problem prevents parsing, a runtime problem interrupts execution, a timeout suggests repetition that never ends, and a wrong answer means the program completed with incorrect state. Choosing the family narrows the next question you should ask.

blocks.caption: Subtracting one converts the item count into the final valid **index**.
Use the collection count to compute its final valid **index**.

blocks.body: For two rooms, length is two but the valid **indexes** are zero and one. The wrong line reads **index** two and receives undefined. A useful debugging log would show both `rooms.length` and the index immediately before access.

blocks.title: Trace this carefully
blocks.body: A **stack** trace can include library frames; start with the first frame naming your source **file** and inspect that line.

blocks.prompt: What family is a missing parenthesis?
blocks.why: The parser cannot complete the call, so execution never begins.

choices: index two is past the end
blocks.why: A two-item **array** has **indexes** zero and one, making two out of bounds.

debug-01.title: Assignment can erase a count
debug-01.body: A counter should move from old value to new value. Setting it to a constant each pass loses the running count.
debug-01.notice: Look for whether the variable accumulates or gets overwritten.
debug-01.mistake: Do not call a loop correct just because it visits every item.

debug-02.title: Compare when asking a question
debug-02.body: A condition should test a value, not assign a value by accident.
debug-02.notice: Check equality syntax anywhere an `if` is asking yes or no.
debug-02.mistake: Do not use assignment syntax when the branch needs a comparison.

debug-03.title: Start index controls skipped items
debug-03.body: An index loop that starts at 1 skips the item at index 0.
debug-03.notice: For scan-all code, verify the first and last indexes visited.
debug-03.mistake: Do not assume `len` is wrong when the start boundary is the real issue.

debug-04.title: Syntax errors often come from one missing closer
debug-04.body: A line can fail before logic runs because a parenthesis, bracket, quote, or semicolon is missing.
debug-04.notice: Match each opener with its closer before changing the algorithm.
debug-04.mistake: Do not debug variable values when the parser cannot read the line.

debug-05.title: An expression must be stored to matter
debug-05.body: Calculating `total + n` alone does not update total. The result must be assigned or returned.
debug-05.notice: Find the line where state should change and check whether it actually writes the new value.
debug-05.mistake: Do not mistake a calculation for an update.

debug-06.title: Indexes stop before length
debug-06.body: The last valid index is one less than the collection length.
debug-06.notice: For out-of-range errors, compare the requested index with the valid index list.
debug-06.mistake: Do not use the length itself as a valid index.

debug-07.title: Return can end a search too early
debug-07.body: A return inside a loop stops the whole function, not just the current pass.
debug-07.notice: For search loops, put the failure return after the loop has checked every item.
debug-07.mistake: Do not return false after the first non-match unless only the first item matters.

debug-p1-08.title: One extra index is still out of range
debug-p1-08.body: Looping through length plus one allows an index equal to the length, which is outside the collection.
debug-p1-08.notice: Check the final loop value before checking the collection access.
debug-p1-08.mistake: Do not include the length as an index in zero-based collections.
